stories.title: A killer gets resentenced over an AI video of his victim forgiving him
stories.summary: An Arizona man convicted of killing a man in a road-rage incident will be resentenced because the court was shown an AI-generated video of the victim forgiving him. The victim's sister wrote the script, in which he says they "probably could have been friends." Dexerto's post got 51K likes, a quote post reading "blow the world up" got 79K, and replies called it "actual Black Mirror behavior."
